title: Eggless Banana Bread Muffins
subtitle: One-bowl banana bread muffins — moist, flavourful and egg-free, with an optional vanilla glaze.

method.title: Mix the batter
items: Preheat the oven to 400°F; line a 12-cup muffin tin with {@liners} (or spray the tin and skip the liners)
In a large bowl, mash {@bananas} with a fork until only small chunks remain
Add {@brown-sugar}, {@oil}, {@yogurt} and {@vanilla:batter}; mix until well combined
Combine wet and dry until just combined — don't over-mix

method.title: Bake
items: Fill any empty cups with a little water so the tin heats evenly
Place the tin in the oven and immediately reduce the temperature to 350°F
Bake about 20 min, until a toothpick in the centre comes out clean and the tops are turning golden
Cool 5 min in the pan, then move to a wire rack to finish cooling

method.label: Toddler — her muffin (before the glaze)
items: Set one muffin aside unglazed — the bananas already make it sweet enough
Serve it warm, broken into small pieces

method.title: Glaze and store
items: Add {@milk} a teaspoon at a time until the glaze reaches the consistency you like
Drizzle over the cooled muffins, if you like
Keeps 3 days covered at room temperature, a week in the fridge, or 3 months frozen — thaw overnight in the fridge and warm in the microwave

method.label: Tip
method.text: Flour: all-purpose, whole wheat or gluten-free all work. Oil: any light-tasting oil — canola, coconut or vegetable. Sugar: raw cane or coconut sugar instead of brown sugar is fine.
